paite: Hiai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Israel suante an ngawl kawm leh sai-ip puansilh kawm leh atung ua lei kibuak kawm in akikhawm ua.
heading: Mipite'n Akhelhna Uh Apuang Uh
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackcloth, and earth on them.

paite: Huchi in Israel chite mikhual tengteng a kipan in akikoihtuam ua, adingh ua akhelhnate uleh, apipute uh thulimlouhnate thupha atawi uhi.
english: The seed of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

paite: Amun uah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh Dan laibu sung ah ni khat a aseh lina teng asim ua; aseh lina teng thupha atawi ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh abeta uhi.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed, and worshiped Yahweh their God.

paite: Huchih lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani leh Kenanite dohkan tung ah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian kiang uah aw ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
english: Then Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

paite: Huai lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah leh Pethahiahte'n, "Dingh unla tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in TOUPA na Pathian uh vualzawl un: huchi in vualzawlna leh phatna tengteng tunglam a tawisang a om, na min thupi vualzawl in om hen.”
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Bessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

paite: "Nang, nang kia mahmah TOUPA na hi; van, vante' van a, sepaihte tengteng, lei leh asung a thil om tengteng, tuipite leh asung ua om tengteng na bawl a, avek un na hawi a; van sepaihte'n nang ahon bia uhi.
heading: Khelh Kipuanna Thumna
english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

paite: Abram tel a, Kaldaite Ur a kipan a amah pikhia a, akiang a Abraham min pepa, TOUPA Pathian na hi;
english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham,

paite: Na ma a lungtang ginom na mu a, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Jebus mite leh Girgas mite gam pe ding a amah toh thukhun bawlpa, achite kiang a pe ding in, na thute bawl piching a; nang lah na diktat ngal a.
english: and found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his seed, and have performed your words; for you are righteous.

paite: Aigupta a ka pipute uh gimthuakna na mu a, Tuipi San a akah uh na za a;
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds ,

paite: Pharaoh tung leh, asikhate tengteng tung leh, agam a mite tengteng tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte na ensak a; amaute siatna ding in kisatheitak in agamtang uh chih lah na thei ngal hi; tuni a bang in, min na kimuh hi.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, and against all his servants, and against all the people of his land; for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is this day.

paite: Ama uah tuipi na khen a, huchi in gam hul tung ah tuipi lak ah apaisuak ua; amau delhte nang tui thuk sung ah, tui hattak sung a suang bang in na pailut hi.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

paite: Huai lou in sun in meipi kitung in amaute na pi a; zan in meikuang dingh in, apaina ding lampi ua vakna amaute kiang a pe ding in.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

paite: Sinai Tang ah leng na hohsuk a, van a kipan in amau na houpih a, vaihawmna dikte leh dan dikte, dan thuseh leh thupiak hoihte na pia hi.
english: “You came down also on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

paite: Amau kiang ah na Sabbath siangthou na theisak a, na sikha Mosi khut in, thupiakte leh dan thusehte leh dan amaute na thupiak in na pia hi.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, and statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

paite: Agilkial un van a kipan tanghou na pia a, adangtak un suangpi a kipan amaute a ding in tui na pawtkhesak a, amaute pe ding a na khut na lik a, gam luah ding a kuan ding in amaute thu na pia hi.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

paite: Himahleh amaute leh apipute un kisatheitak in ahih ua, apaupeng ua, na thupiakte angaikhe kei uhi,
english: “But they and our fathers dealt proudly and hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

paite: Thu amang nuam kei ua, alak ua na hih na thillamdangte leng alimsak sam kei uh; himahleh aki-uangsak ua, ahelna uah atanna ua kik nawn ding in heutu khat asep uhi; himahleh nang ngaidam dia mansa, lainatna a dim leh hehpihsiam, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, amaute lehngatsan lou Pathian na hi.
english: and refused to obey, neither were they mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

paite: Ahi, bawngnou sun abawl lai un, Aigupta a kipan a nang hon pikhepa hiai na Pathian ahi, achi ua, nakpitak a thangpaihnate abawl lai un.
english: Yes, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies;

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute gamdai ah na lehngatsan kei hi: sun in atung ua kipan meipi dingh apaimang kei a, vakna amau pe ding, zan a meikuang dingh leng, apaina lampi uah amaute pi ding in.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness: the pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

paite: Amaute chil ding in na kha hoih na pia a, akam uah na Manna na phal lou kei a, amaute adangtak un tui na pia hi.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

paite: Ahi, gamdai ah kum sawmli amaute na vak a, bangmah atasam kei ua; apuansilhte uh atul kei a, akhepekte uh abawk kei hi.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

paite: Huai ban ah lalgamte leh mite amau na pia a, atantuante uh dungzui a na piakkhiakte: Sihon gam, Heshbon kumpipa gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam alata uhi.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

paite: Van aksite bang in atate uh na pungsak a, nei ding in alut ding uh chi a, api-le-pute kiang a na gen bang in, gamsung ah na pilut hi.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.

paite: Huchi in tate alut ua gam aneita ua, ama uah gam a tengte na satpuka, Kanaante, akumpite leh, gam a mite, amau khut ah na pia a, huchi a a-utdan ua atung ua ahihtheihna ding un.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land, and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

paite: Khopi hatte, gam hoihte ala ua, thil hoih tengteng a dim innte anei ua, tuibel sekte, grephuante, olive huante, atam a tam theikungte: huchi in ane ua, avah ua, ahong thau ua, na hoihna thupi ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They took fortified cities, and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, and olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

paite: Hinapi'n lah thu amang kei ua, na tung ah ahel ua, na dan anunglam uah apai ua, na kiang lam amaute ngasak nawn ding a, amaute dem a thugen na zawlneite athat ua, thangpaihna thupi mahmah abawl uhi.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, and cast your law behind their back, and killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

paite: Huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na pia a, amau ahihgenthei uh: abuai ni ua na kiang a ahong kah lai un, van a kipan in na za a; na zahngaihna tampi dungzui in amelmate uh khut a kipan a amaute hondam ding in akiang uah hondam mite na pia hi.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hand of their adversaries.

paite: Himahleh atawldam nung un na ma ah gilou ahih nawn zel ua; huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na nusia a, huchi in amau atung uah thu anei ua: hinapi in ahong kihei ua, na kiang a akah un, van a kipan na za a; na zahngaihnate dungzui in amaute tamveipi na hunkhia hi.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore left you them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned, and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

paite: Na dan a na pilut theih nawnna ding in, amau na dem a: himahleh kisatheitak in ahih ua, na thupiakte alimsak kei ua, na vaihawmte tung ah akhial zosop uhi, huai mi'n ahihleh, huai ah ahing ding, liang asawisak ua, aki-uangsak ua, aza nuam kei uhi.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they dealt proudly, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances, (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

paite: Himahleh kum tampi amau na thuakzou a, na zawlneite in na kha zang in amaute na dem a, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei ua; huaiziak in gam mite khut ah amaute na peta hi.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet would they not give ear. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute na hihbei keuhkeuh kei a, na lehngatsan kei; nang lah hehpih thei leh chingthei Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you did not make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka Pathian uh, thupi Pathian hat leh kihtakhuai, thukhun leh zahngaihna vompa, na ma ah, ka tung uh, ka kumpipate uh tung, ka vaihawmte uh tung, ka siampute uh tung, ka zawlneite uh tung, ka pipute uh tung, na mite, Assuria kumpipate dam lai a kipan a tuni tan, na mite tung a, nauveina bangmah tham lou bang in kilang kei hen.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you, that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh ka tung ua hong tung tengteng ah nang na diktat a; nang lah diktak in na hih ngal a, kou bel giloutak in ka hih uhi.
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly;

paite: Kumpipate leh ka vaihawmte uh hiam, siampute uh hiam, ka pipute uh hiam in na dan azui kei ua, na thupiakte leh na thu theihpihnate, amaute dem a na theihpihnate lah angaikhe nuam sam kei uhi.
english: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

paite: Agam uah nang nna asem kei ua, na hoih mahmahna ziak a amau na piak, ama ua na piak gam lian leh hoih, anasep gilou ua kipan akilehhei sam kei uhi.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them, neither did they turn from their wicked works.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in sikhate ka hi ua, agah nekna ding leh huai ahoihte neihna dia ka pipute uh kiang a na piak gam ahihleh, ngai in, asung ah sikhate ka hi uhi.
english: “Behold, we are servants this day, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

paite: Ka khelhna ziak ua ka tung ua na koih kumpipate a ding in anak pun mahmah a, athuthu un, ka pumpite uleh, ka gantate uh tung athilhihtheihna anei ua, kou ka nak gim mahmah uhi."
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins: also they have power over our bodies, and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

paite: Huan hiaite tengteng huchibang hita mahleh thukhun muanhuai ka bawl ua, ka gelh ua; ka vaihawmte uh, ka Levi mite uleh ka siampute un, huai ah suai akai uhi.
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”
